subject: Language-guest workstream, JavaScript half (the JavaScript-guest blocker) qualified against the exact built 1.2.0 wheel — JavaScript Preview1 guest built reproducibly with Javy and executed through the isolated Cell sandbox from a fresh install

artifact_under_test.install: uv venv (CPython 3.12) + `uv pip install --offline dist/ephemora_cell-1.2.0-py3-none-any.whl` plus pinned wasmtime==49.0.0; nothing imported from the source tree (verified via __file__ under site-packages)
artifact_under_test.wheel_sha256_binding: see release_identity.json / fresh_install_qualification.json for the wheel and native-engine digests

toolchain.install: pinned local build (javy 9.1.0 release binary); not on npm/brew, not auto-provisioned in CI — supplied out-of-band via EPHEMORA_JAVY_BIN, nothing fetched at Cell execution time
toolchain.engine_embedded_in_guest: Javy bundles a QuickJS-in-WASM runtime; the guest is a self-contained Preview1 module

guest: reads a JSON object on stdin ({"n":10,"msg":"baz"}), computes {"answer":40,"echo":"baz!"} and writes it to stdout; exercised through ephemora_cell.lang_js.run_javascript_module on the isolated subprocess path

byte_reproducibility.evidence: consecutive Javy 9.1.0 builds of the same source yield differing sha256 at constant size (observed: ee8ce9d4..., 7f91fc98..., 0901ee7b...)
byte_reproducibility.consequence: a shipped versioned [javascript] package must pin the digest of one build-once artifact and distribute those exact bytes; the qualify gate binds expected_sha256 and a wrong digest is refused before the guest runs (no hidden download, fail-closed)

security_note: the JS guest runs on the WASI Preview1 path inside the disposable worker; the component isolation gate (component_guard.py) is wired into the wasi_02 component loader (the first release blocker, commit 2de40fd) and is present in this 1.2.0 wheel. This run is one positive data point, NOT a reachability proof that closes GHSA-32h6; that advisory stays open / release-blocking.
still_gated: publishing versioned ephemora-cell[javascript] distribution (PyPI upload requires separate authorization; recipe + entry-point packaging built but not published)
license / SBOM clearance for redistributing the embedded QuickJS dependency tree inside the BUSL package
Javy toolchain auto-provisioning in CI (brought from a pinned local build, not downloaded by CI)
end-to-end qualification against the actually-published package on a fresh install (requires the publish step)
